The control panel on the left unit has a digital display and a red emergency stop button.
The engines appear to be diesel-powered, with visible exhaust pipes and cooling systems.
The units are placed outdoors on a grassy and concrete area, with some debris around.
The enclosures are white with black side panels; one unit has a black panel partially open.
No brand or model name is visible on the units in either photo.
The seller claims 'very very clean' and lists 20kva, 27kva, 30kva, but no specific model or capacity is shown in the photos.
